summary: Short six-block page: purple head with a photo and coral shapes, four principle cards, a communication rhythm list with a quote card, three photo tiles, three virtual-tour videos and a cream call-to-action. Needs four principles, a four-line meeting rhythm, three tiles and optional office videos.
